scope: official fp16 CTC Chrome WebGPU phase attribution

method.phaseMetrics: executor metrics now separate JS preprocessing, ORT encoder session.run(), and CTC decode/readback
method.note: The browser profile uses the local official fp16 artifact and exact JFK fixture. Absolute timings include provider/shader-cache variance; phase shares guide prioritization rather than serving as a cross-device benchmark.

decision.reason: The WebGPU encoder dominates the measured warm transcribe path. CTC readback/argmax is under 1% of wall time, so tensor-copy or decoder-loop surgery is not a high-value target for this family. Prioritize the mel path and encoder graph/provider behavior, then re-profile before changing placement.
